blocks.html: A Vertical Market is a specific industry segment that a company targets with tailored products, services, and messaging designed to meet sector-specific needs (e.g., healthcare, manufacturing, finance).

Vertical markets allow businesses to specialize in serving one industry with deeper expertise and more relevant solutions. This often leads to stronger positioning, better customer trust, and higher conversion rates.

blocks.html: Companies may target one vertical or expand into multiple verticals over time.
A SaaS company builds separate solutions for healthcare clinics, manufacturers, and financial firms, each with customized workflows.
A Vertical Market is an industry-specific segment where businesses tailor offerings to meet specialized customer needs.
